consequence.statement: This is an additive feature with opt-in semantics; environments that do not explicitly enable the AND operator option will retain existing sync windows matching behavior.

original.statement: An AND operator opt-in option for sync windows matches was added in Argo CD 3.0.0.

decision.reason: [ev-61a7d576a759] lists this under Features and calls the AND operator an "opt-in option" for sync window matches. An opt-in option only takes effect when an operator turns it on. So an environment that does nothing keeps its current matching behaviour, and "none" (informational) is the right consequence. The evidence says nothing about anything failing, being rejected or a default changing.
